snippet.title: BitESC LaunchTrailer - BREAK OUT NOW!
snippet.description:
Break free from the system and set out as Bit to escape from the tyrannic OS. Gaining your freedom, though, might not be as clear-cut as it seems…

EXPLORE THE DIGITAL WORLD
Traverse the desktop, delve into the forgotten depths of the recycle bin, be immersed into game worlds (literally!) and more. You’ll overcome frantic challenges, unwind with mini-games and uncover the shrouded secrets of the OS.

DYNAMIC & TIGHT ACTION
Platform your way through hundreds of challenges and puzzles with an expansive moveset and simple-tight controls along with various accessibility options to aid you in your journey.

MEET THE COLORFUL LOCALS OF THE OS
Stumble into lively towns and cities and meet the colorful locals of the digital world. Some will help you along your journey, others might have more devious motives.

BE CAREFUL WHAT YOU WISH FOR
You’ll need to make several tough decisions along the way that could affect you, the friends you’ve made and even the whole digital world.

Bit ESC is OUT NOW on Xbox & Steam.

🎮 Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/bit-esc/9nlfrhpfm4vt
🎮 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1724490/Bit_ESC/
